name: agentguards-codex
description: LLM security guardrails for OpenAI Codex — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization. Enforced by hooks on every prompt, shell command, fetched page and file edit.

interface.longDescription: AgentGuards screens what Codex does — every prompt and every shell command — and surfaces anything risky for approval before it runs. Enforcing hooks provide jailbreak and prompt-injection detection, web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization. Nothing for the model to call: the hooks act on their own. Fail-closed by default; switch to fail-open with a single environment variable.
defaultPrompt: Confirm AgentGuards guardrails are active and the service is healthy.
Explain how AgentGuards screens my prompts and shell commands.
